newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM says margins not yet at '96 levels.
newsitem.headline: DSM says margins not yet at '96 levels.

text.p: Dutch chemicals group DSM NV said on Wednesday operating margins had not yet recovered to year-earlier levels despite higher sales prices in the first 1997 half.
"Despite the rise in sales prices, margins (sales price per tonne minus variable costs) did not yet reach the level of the first half of 1996," DSM said in a statement.
In addition fixed costs rose, partly as a result of acquisitions and expansion, it said.
The company earlier reported first-half net profits up 13 percent at 465 million guilders. Operating profits picked up 10 percent to 642 million guilders.
